title: Laid-Back Camp Season 4's Trailer Unveils April 2027 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of Afro 's Laid-Back Camp manga presented the main trailer and main visual for the anime's fourth season on Friday. The trailer and visual announce the season's April 2027 premiere, and the trailer also previews the theme songs.

The trailer features artist Asaka 's opening theme song "Brand New.," artist Eri Sasaki 's ending theme song "Happa no Tegami" (Leaf Letter), and the band Kiminone 's overall series theme song "Tonari ni Ireba."

The returning cast members include:

• Yumiri Hanamori as Nadeshiko Kagamihara

• Nao Tōyama as Rin Shima

• Sayuri Hara as Chiaki Ōgaki

• Aki Toyosaki as Aoi Inuyama

• Rie Takahashi as Ena Saitō

• Tomoyo Kurosawa as Ayano Toki

• Maria Sashide as Ema Mizunami

• Kokoa Amano as Mei Nakatsugawa

• Akio Ōtsuka as Narrator

Shin Tosaka returns from the third season to direct the new season at FuRyu Pictures , replacing 8-Bit from the previous season. Pierre Sugiura (also known as Masafumi Sugiura ) is again in charge of series scripts. Ryūta Ura ( Demon Slayer – Kimetsu no Yaiba – The Movie: Mugen Train , Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel trilogy films key animator) is the new character designer, replacing Hisanori Hashimoto from last season. Akiyuki Tateyama returns as the composer, and Takeshi Takadera returns as the sound director.

The anime's first season premiered in January 2018, and Crunchyroll streamed the 12-episode series as it aired. Crunchyroll also streamed an English dub of the first season. The second season of the anime premiered in January 2021.

An anime film based on the manga opened in July 2022, and Crunchyroll began streaming the film in November 2022.

A live-action television series adaptation of the original manga premiered in January 2019.

The anime inspired MAGES ' Yurucamp Have a Nice Day! game that launched for PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch in November 2022. Gemdrops released the Laid-Back Camp - Virtual - Lake Motosu ( Yurucamp Virtual Camp Motosuko-hen ) VR game in March 2021, and released the Laid-Back Camp - Virtual - Fumoto Campsite ( Yurucamp Virtual Camp Fumoto Camp Jō-hen ) VR game in April 2022.

Laid-Back Camp All-in-one!! , the first smartphone game in the franchise , was released worldwide in June 2023. Cozy Trail Games' Yurukyan△ ~Puzzle Camp~ ( Laid-Back Camp : Puzzle Camp) smartphone puzzle game launched in July 2024.

Afro launched the manga in Houbunsha 's Manga Time Kirara Forward magazine in 2015, and moved it to Houbunsha 's Comic Fuz manga website in 2019. Yen Press began releasing the manga in English in March 2018.

title: 'Kizuguchi to Houtai' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Opening Theme, First Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nanai Umihoshi 's Kizuguchi to Houtai ( Wound and Bandage ) manga revealed additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), the opening theme, and first promotional video on Friday. The anime series will premiere on January 9, 2027 at 11:00 p.m. on AT-X, followed by ABC TV and TV Asahi on the ANiMAZiNG programming block.

Cast Shouta Kawaramori: Kou Bonkobara ( Danjo no Yuujou wa Seiritsu suru? (Iya, Shinai!!) ) Mamoru Fujiyoshida: Kengo Takanashi ( Dorohedoro ) Narrator: Tomokazu Sugita ( Nageki no Bourei wa Intai shitai )

Staff Art Director: Masaru Amamizu ( Nozo x Kimi ) Color Design: Miho Kimura ( Shinigami Bocchan to Kuro Maid ) Director of Photography: Kaori Omatsu ( Yarinaoshi Reijou wa Ryuutei Heika wo Kouryakuchuu ) Editing: Kentarou Tsubone (REAL-T) ( [Oshi no Ko] ) Music: KOHTA YAMAMOTO ( 86 ), Misaki Umase ( Henjin no Salad Bowl ) Sound Director: Jin Aketagawa ( Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu ) Sound Production: Magic Capsule

Guitarist and vocalist MIYAVI ( Kokkoku ) is performing the opening theme "Show Me All Your Pain," which previewed in the first promotional video below.

Miyuki Ishida ( Danjo no Yuujou wa Seiritsu suru? (Iya, Shinai!!) assistant director) is helming the anime at J.C.Staff , with Susumu Yamakawa ( Gokushufudou series composition) penning the script and handling the series composition. Natsuki Ooyama ( 2.5-jigen no Ririsa animation director) is designing the characters.

Umihoshi originally began the manga as a one-shot in Getsumaga Kichi magazine in February 2024. The manga began serializing in Comic Days magazine the following August. Kodansha published the fifth volume on July 16.

title: He Does a Body Good Webtoon Gets AnimeFesta Anime in January 2027
content:
Suiseisha announced on Friday that Lee Wonsik and Park Hyeongjun's He Does a Body Good ( Karada ni Ii Otoko ) webtoon is inspiring an AnimeFesta anime that will premiere next January. The anime's website notes that WWWave Corporation 's OceanVeil service will stream the anime in English.

Lee Wonsik and Park Hyeongjun serialized the webtoon in Lezhin Comics from November 2014 to March 2017. The webtoon is available in Korea, English, and Japanese. Both the Japanese print release of the webtoon and the anime's website credit the original work to "WS," and the art to "YUKIO." The Japanese version also changes the characters' names from Korean to Japanese. Frontier Works releases the webtoon in print in Japan. The article will use the Japanese names of the characters provided in the anime's official website.

The anime's cast includes:

Atsushi Hizashi as Hiroki Nagai

Ion Momoyama as Yumi Aihara

Towa Miyako as Risa Ogawa

Milk Amai as Ayano Yamaguchi

Nishiyan is directing the anime at Studio Hōkiboshi . Eeyo Kurosaki is in charge of the series scripts. Reina Nasu is the character designer and chief animation director. Akahori is the color key artist. Chan Do Kim Fan is credited as both art director and for art setting. Shurakura Hōōin is the compositing director of photography. Kanedo is the editor. Yūichi Imaizumi is the sound director. The studio sonilude is handling the sound production.

The anime's website describes the anime:

One touch of this guy and you're sure to reach ecstasy!

A man going about his dismal life —a woman on his commuter train getting repulsed by him, getting suckered by a former classmate in a shady business scheme— transforms into a man with a new physical ability from a certain accident.

That is… when someone touches him, they feel incredibly good?! This is a strange story of a man who makes you feel pleasure every time you touch him!

TOUCH AND ECSTASY… IT'S SHOWTIME!

WWWave Corporation owns the ComicFesta web manga service, as well as the AnimeFesta anime programming block. AnimeFesta (formerly Anime Zone and ComicFesta Anime ) has produced short anime adaptations of more than 30 manga from ComicFesta in the past eight years, with many of the manga being adult or risqué in nature. The first AnimeFesta anime was On a Lustful Night Mingling with a Priest ( Sōryo to Majiwaru Shikiyoku no Yoru ni... ), whose Japanese title has led to AnimeFesta anime sometimes being called "Sōryo-waku" (Sōryo-type) by fans. Most of the anime series have two different versions: a "broadcast" version (the censored version aired on television), and a "premium" uncensored version distributed online. WWWave Corporation releases many of the anime titles in English on its Coolmic website, and recently began releasing anime on OceanVeil .

title: Booty Royale: Never Go Down Without a Fight! Manga Gets TV Anime in January
content:
WWWave Corporation announced on Friday that its Deregula anime label is producing an anime adaptation of Rui Takatō 's Booty Royale: Never Go Down Without a Fight! ( Hagure Idol Jigokuhen ) manga that will premiere in January 2027. Takatō drew the below illustration to celebrate the anime's announcement:

The anime's cast includes:

• Hisako Tōjō as Misora Haebaru

• Nao Shiraki as Sarah Goujima

• Natsumi Murakami as Chae Yoon-Hee

• Hikaru Iida as Nene Kori

Takashi Andō ( My Life as Inukai-san's Dog , My Girlfriend's Friend ) is directing the anime at Raiose . Eeyo Kurosaki ( Yoasobi Gurashi , Do You Like Big Girls? , The Lonely Snow Widow and the Cursed Ring ) is both writing and supervising the series' scripts. Ryūji Iwata ( My Girlfriend's Friend ) is designing the characters. Morimori is the chief animation director. ZincP is composing the music.

Yutaka Aota is directing the art, while Do Kim Hoan Tran is credited for art setting. Riku Saito is in charge of color setting. Tomohiro Hayashi is the compositing director of photography and the editor. Akinori Shiba is directing the sound at the studio Object.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga under its Ghost Ship adult imprint, and it describes the story:

Eighteen-year-old karate expert Misora Haebaru moves to Tokyo to pursue her dream of becoming a famous singer. Unfortunately, her sleazy handlers trick her into the adult entertainment industry instead. Her only way out is to survive a martial arts tournament where she must fight her way through one hundred lustful male opponents. If she loses, she will pay the ultimate erotic price!

The manga launched in Nihonbungeisha 's Bessatsu Manga Goraku magazine in February 2014. The magazine ended publication in December 2014, and the series moved to Manga Goraku Special in March 2015. Nihonbungeisha shipped the manga's 19th compiled book volume on April 28. Seven Seas Entertainment released the manga's eighth omnibus volume (corresponding to the original volumes 17-18) on July 14. The manga inspired a live-action film that opened in Japan in September 2020.

The manga had entered its climax in July 2021. Takatō had stated in 2022 that he was retiring from drawing manga due to circumstances at his home making it difficult to constantly draw manga about "boobs and sex," and with his retirement announcement, the manga went on hiatus. Takatō returned to the industry and resumed the manga in March 2024.

Takatō's Pale Blue Dot Battle Athletes Daiundōkai ReSTART! manga is a completely new story for the 90s multimedia franchise Battle Athletes Victory . The manga's prologue debuted on Jitsugyo no Nihon Sha's manga website Comic Ruelle & Comic Jardi in June 2020, and ended in March 2021. The manga inspired an anime adaptation that premiered in Japan in April 2021, and Funimation streamed the show as it aired.

The anime series will premiere in January 2027.

Cast Misora Haebaru: Hisako Toujou ( Boushoku no Berserk ) Sarah Goujima: Nao Shiraki ( Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjou, Aruiwa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen ) Yun-Hui Choi: Natsumi Murakami ( Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai ) Nene Koori: Hikaru Iida ( Kimi wa Meido-sama. )

Staff Director: Takashi Andou ( Inu ni Nattara Suki na Hito ni Hirowareta. ) Series Composition: Eiyo Kurosaki ( Ingoku Danchi ) Character Design: Ryuuji Iwata ( Kanojo no Tomodachi ) Chief Animation Director: Morimori ( Ai no Utagoe wo Kikasete key animation) Art Director: Minoru Aota ( Android wa Keiken Ninzuu ni Hairimasu ka?? ) Art Design: Do Kim Hoan Tran ( Marika-chan no Koukando wa Bukkowareteiru ) Color Design: Riku Saitou ( Egao no Daika color specification) Director of Photography: Tomohiro Hayashi ( Hitozuma no Kuchibiru wa Kan Chuuhai no Aji ga Shite ) Editing: Tomohiro Hayashi Sound Director: Akinori Shiba ( Ookii Onnanoko wa Suki desu ka? ) Sound Production: Object Music: ZincP Producer: Deregula Studio: Raiose Production: WWWave

Takatou began serializing the ecchi comedy manga in Bessatsu Manga Goraku from April 2014 to December 25 that year. The series later moved to Manga Goraku Special in March 2015. The manga went on hiatus in September 2022 and resumed serialization in March 2024, before moving to the Goraku Web! in June 2025. Nihonbungeisha published the 19th volume on April 28.

A spin-off manga, titled Hagure Idol Jigoku-hen Gaiden: Princess Sarah , was serialized on the Goraku Egg platform from April 2015 to December 2015. The first and final volume was released in February 2016.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga in English under its Ghost Ship mature reader imprint in 2-in-1 omnibus editions in December 2020. The 17th and 18th volume went on sale on July 14.

A live-action movie adaptation, produced by Sedic Deux, premiered in Japan in September 2020.

Unfortunately, her sleazy handlers trick her into the adult entertainment industry instead. title: Amahara's 33 Years Old Single Girl Knight Captain Manga Gets Anime
content:
Digital Shokunin annoucned on Friday that it is producing an anime adaptation of manga creator Amahara 's 33-sai Dokushin Onna Kishi Taichō (33 Years Old Single Girl Knight Captain [sic] ) manga. The project's YouTube channel is streaming a music video with a song titled "Boogieing Dance Kishi" (Boogieing Dance Knights) with vocals by Sekka, composition and arrangement by Suzumi, and lyrics by Sekka and Suzumi. ( WARNING: The video below may not be safe for work )

The sex comedy fantasy manga centers on the titular 33-year-old girl and knight captain Mail, as well as her friends, who all suffer from exploitative work conditions and are too busy to sate their sexual desires. They spend what little free time they have drinking and pleasuring themselves.

Amahara launched the manga in KATTS ' online adult manga magazine Ananga Ranga in October 2015, where it is still ongoing irregularly, with every new chapter often only being one or two pages long. Flex Comics published the manga's fourth compiled book volume on January 15.

Amahara and masha 's similar sex comedy fantasy manga Interspecies Reviewers ( Ishuzoku Reviewers ) first ran as a special one-shot in Kadokawa 's Monthly Dragon Age magazine in July 2016, and then later launched in the Dra Dra Sharp# section of the Nico Nico Seiga website in August 2016. Kadokawa published the manga's 12th compiled book volume on October 9. Yen Press licensed the manga and released the 11th volume on April 28.

The manga inspired a television anime premiered in January 2020. Funimation removed the series from its streaming service later in January, stating the company "determined that this series falls outside of [its] standards." The company stated it decided to take down the series altogether instead of altering the content. Amazon Prime Video removed both the English-dubbed and English-subtitled versions of the anime in the first week of February 2020. Right Stuf later licensed and released the anime uncensored on Blu-ray Disc in December 2021.

Amahara serialized the original web manga version of The Idaten Deities Know Only Peace ( Heion Sedai no Idaten-tachi ) manga on the Neetsha website, but abruptly halted it in May 2016. Coolkyoushinja launched a remake of the manga in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine in August 2018. The manga caught up to the older online version of the manga in early 2023, and ended in August 2024. Hakusensha released the manga's ninth and final volume in October 2024. Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing the manga in English, and it released the ninth volume in November 2025. The manga inspired an anime that premiered on Fuji TV 's Noitamina programming block in July 2021. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

The sex comedy fantasy manga centers on the titular 33-year-old girl and knight captain Mail, as well as her friends, who all suffer from exploitative work conditions and are too busy to sate their sexual desires. They spend what little free time they have drinking and pleasuring themselves.

Amahara launched the manga in KATTS ' online adult manga magazine Ananga Ranga in October 2015, where it is still ongoing irregularly, with every new chapter often only being one or two pages long. Flex Comics published the manga's fourth compiled book volume on January 15.

Amahara and masha 's similar sex comedy fantasy manga Interspecies Reviewers ( Ishuzoku Reviewers ) first ran as a special one-shot in Kadokawa 's Monthly Dragon Age magazine in July 2016, and then later launched in the Dra Dra Sharp# section of the Nico Nico Seiga website in August 2016. Kadokawa published the manga's 12th compiled book volume on October 9. Yen Press licensed the manga and released the 11th volume on April 28.

The manga inspired a television anime premiered in January 2020. Funimation removed the series from its streaming service later in January, stating the company "determined that this series falls outside of [its] standards." The company stated it decided to take down the series altogether instead of altering the content. Amazon Prime Video removed both the English-dubbed and English-subtitled versions of the anime in the first week of February 2020. Right Stuf later licensed and released the anime uncensored on Blu-ray Disc in December 2021.

Amahara serialized the original web manga version of The Idaten Deities Know Only Peace ( Heion Sedai no Idaten-tachi ) manga on the Neetsha website, but abruptly halted it in May 2016. Coolkyoushinja launched a remake of the manga in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine in August 2018. The manga caught up to the older online version of the manga in early 2023, and ended in August 2024. Hakusensha released the manga's ninth and final volume in October 2024. Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing the manga in English, and it released the ninth volume in November 2025. The manga inspired an anime that premiered on Fuji TV 's Noitamina programming block in July 2021. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.

title: Despite Fan Backlash, Dragon Ball Super Remake Is One of the Biggest Hits of Fall 2026
content:
Netflix’s weekly ranking chart reveals that Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is one of the biggest hits of the year. The highly anticipated remake became a massive disappointment after the release of Episode 3, which was even before the main battle between Goku and Beerus. This is the first anime that the Dragon Ball franchise released after Daima , which was the final project of Akira Toriyama. Considering the franchise’s popularity, it’s no surprise that the hype was greater than ever, even if the latest anime was a remake rather than a sequel. The animation studio claimed to fix the biggest issues with the original anime adaptations, including the animation quality and the pacing.

However, so far, the anime remake has been rather disappointing considering how it keeps removing fan-favorite scenes while also having exaggerated filters and jarring visuals that are somehow worse than the original version. However, while the anime finds itself in the middle of the controversy, Netflix Tudum reveals that the anime gathered more than 2.2 million views between October 19th and 25th, around the time the anime had only released two episodes. It also ranked ninth among the top 10 global non-English shows, which again proves how much the franchise is loved despite having faced so much backlash.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Continues to Face Controversy With New Episodes

The anime has released four episodes so far, but the battle between Goku and Beerus has yet to begin. While his Super Saiyan God form has been revealed in the latest episode, the anime continues to receive fan backlash for the same reasons . The tone of the story and the light-hearted moments have been shifted in the remake version, which doesn’t appeal to many fans. This is only the first arc of the remake, and the anime still has to adapt the Resurrection F and Universe 6 Arcs. While the remake stayed true to its promise of closely following Toriyama’s version of the story, it feels unnecessarily concise, without the scenes that made the series so loved. Not to mention that the anime leans too heavily on slow-motion pans and still frames, instead of fluid animated sequences, which is another reason why the anime keeps receiving fan backlash.

What’s Next for Dragon Ball Super ?

Earlier this year, Dragon Ball Super confirmed its return with a brand new season that will continue the story after the Tournament of Power Saga. Also known as the Moro Arc, the story follows Goku and Vegeta as they join the Galactic Patrol to fight a prison escapee, Moro, a 10-million-year-old magic user who consumes planets. However, the animation studio has yet to share any details on the anime’s return, considering how the remake has grabbed all of the attention this year. On the other hand, fans are still awaiting the manga’s return with Toyotaro taking over the helm. The extra chapter released in 2025 concluded the Super Hero Saga, so we can expect the manga to return with a brand new adventure.

Do you think Dragon Ball Super: Beerus can turn things around after the Battle of the Gods Arc? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Avatar: Seven Havens
content:
The Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise keeps expanding as the latest animated series was released after 12 years to explore the exceptional worldbuilding and the captivating characters. After its exciting announcement in 2025, Avatar: Seven Havens premiered in October this year and reached its conclusion in the same month. The series released batches of three to four episodes every Friday starting from October 9th. The first season wrapped up in Episode 13 before confirming that the animation series will return with a brand new season. The story this time centers around twin Earthbender sisters, Pavi and Nisha, as they navigate a world where the Avatar is feared among the masses rather than being treated as a savior.

While Paramount has officially confirmed that the series will have four seasons, the next season hasn’t shared any updates so far. It’s only been a week since the first season wrapped up, which means fans will have to wait at least a few months, or even longer, to get updates on Season 2. However, while you wait for the series to return , there are plenty of exciting anime shows set in unique worlds that can keep you busy in the meantime. If you’re looking for stories centering around mystery and magical adventure, these three will be perfect for you.

3) Heavenly Delusion

Heavenly Delusion is one of the wildest and darkest anime of the 2020s, but it never gained the attention it deserved. Similar to Seven Havens , it’s set in a post-apocalyptic world as the protagonists navigate through the dangers in order to reach a place called Heaven. This sci-fi mystery takes place 15 years after a massive disaster struck human civilization, and now dangerous man-eating monsters roam around the land. As humanity is on the brink of collapse, an isolated facility shelters children and keeps them away from potential harm. The anime, produced by Production I.G., received acclaim right after its debut but was never confirmed for a second season. Maru and Kiruko are two young survivors who wish to live in a peaceful world, but as their search for Heaven continues, the story unfolds their past burdens and secrets as they try to find a better place in the broken world.

2) Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood

There are hardly any anime series that can come close to the exceptional worldbuilding, layers of mysteries, and complex characters like Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood . The story is not only popular for its incredible story, but also for having one of the most satisfying endings in Shonen history. Fans of Avatar: Seven Havens will love this anime as it focuses on siblings’ bond while also dealing with the cost that comes with power. The 64-episode-long series follows the tale of two brothers who embark on a journey to search for the legendary Philosopher’s Stone and reclaim what they lost. However, amid their search, they get entangled in the centuries-long scheme that has been taking place in their country, as everything seems to be connected to the dark truth behind the legendary object. While the manga received an anime adaptation in 2003 , it severely deviated from the original manga, but this reboot saved the franchise.

1) Moribito: Guardian of the Spirit

Hardly any anime fan these days even remembers or talks about this forgotten masterpiece. The story spans across 26 episodes, following the themes of survival and redemption as a young woman decides to save the life of a prince. Much like Seven Havens , this underrated anime features the same grounded, martial-arts fight choreography, powers related to the spiritual realm, and heavy moral dilemmas as the fate of the world hangs in the balance. Set in a land that resembles medieval Japan while also incorporating Chinese and Mongolian culture, the story follows the journey of Balsa, who saves a young prince, Chagum, from an assassination attempt. She later accepts the request of Chagum’s mother to save his life after learning that the boy’s father, the Emperor, is targeting him. As the duo’s journey continues, the truth behind Chagum’s identity and the prophecy that threatens the entire kingdom comes to light.

Do you agree with our picks – or have an anime you’d like to recommend that shares similar vibes to Avatar: Seven Havens ? Let us know in the comments below.

title: Ninja Skooler Anime Unveils Pilot Film, Images, Song
content:
Makoto Kimura 's BLUE RIGHTS anime planning company unveiled on Friday a pilot film and images for Kinema Citrus ' original anime project Ninja Skooler . The company also digitally released the featured song "Knots" written and performed by Takashi Iwami .

The company describes the story:

Rappa is an orphan who idolizes fictional ninja. One snowy night, he falls from a rooftop and is saved by a real ninja named Okachimachi and his master. Rappa turns up at their door asking to become an apprentice, and the three begin living together as a family. Years later, Rappa throws himself into training to become a ninja who can protect the town. The children who look up to him gather at the master's traditional Japanese candy shop, a place where he can laugh with family and friends. Rappa thinks these days will last forever, but he sees Okachimachi tending to their retired master and catches a glimpse of the pain the master has kept hidden...

Shunsuke Takarai is directing and supervising the Ninja Skooler with character designs by Hami . The anime is based on a concept by Kinema Citrus .

The staff also includes:

• Key Animators: Yuka Kuroda, Franziska van Wulfen, Shunsuke Takarai

• In-between Checker: Aoi Higuchi

• In-between Checker Assistance: Studio BUS, Min Kyung-ae

• In-betweeners: Gift-o'-Animation (Keito Suzuki, Mizuki Hori), Studio BUS (Min Kyung-ae, Park Kyung-sook, Min Su-in, Shin Sun-mi, Jang Yun-young, On Nuri Park)

• Color Key Artist/Coordinator/Checker: Hiroaki Kaguchi

• Finishing: Hiroaki Kaguchi, Anitus-Kobe, YOSHIKI Eri, Studio BUS (Na Jong-ah, Kim seo-young, Kim Jung-hye, Kim Yeon-mi, Kim Eun-kyeoung, Baek Sung-hee, Kim Mi-yeon, Lee Jeong Mi)

• Background Art: Hami, Shunsuke Takarai

• Compositing Director of Photography/Editor: Shinichirō Miyazaki

• Sound Director/Mixing: Haru Yamada

• Sound Effects: Tōru Noguchi

• Audio Production: Sound Team Donjuan

• Music: Nanatsukaze(PIKASONIC＆nakotanmaru)

• Studio Management: Kōji Sone, Naoko Matsumoto, Michiko Akima, Tomoka Kuwahara, Naruhito Mitsuwaka

• System Management: Takanori Sunaga, Shigeo Miyagi

• Creative Department Management: Kensuke Aoshima, Miyu Inoue

• Translation: Hiromi Hasegawa, Jorge Herrera

• Vehicle Coorporation: Komatsu Tsusho Co., Ltd.

• Animation Producers: Muneki Ogasawara, Satoshi Wada

• Production Assistant: Satoshi Wada

• Animation Production/Based on concept by: Kinema Citrus

Kinema Citrus originally announced the anime at the Anime Central event in Rosemont, IL in May 2024.

title: Mashle: Magic and Muscles Manga Gets Live-Action Film on March 19
content:
An early teaser visual announced on Wednesday that a live-action film of Hajime Kōmoto 's Mashle: Magic and Muscles manga will open on March 19, 2027. Warner Brothers and Fuji TV are overseeing the project, and CREDEUS is producing. TOHO will distribute the film.

The tagline on the visual above reads, "It's finally time for a movie adaptation, Mashle."

Both Viz Media 's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service published the manga digitally in English. Viz Media is also releasing the manga in print. Shueisha describes the manga:

This is a world of magic where magic is used for everything. But deep in the forest exists a young man who spends his time training and bulking up. He can't use magic, but he enjoys a peaceful life with his father. But one day, his life is put in danger! Will his muscular body protect him from the magic users who are out to get him? Powerfully trained muscles crush magic as this abnormal magical fantasy begins!

The series launched in Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in Japan in January 2020, and ended in July 2023. Shueisha published the manga's 18th and final compiled book volume, as well as a fan book, in October 2023.

The anime adaptation's first season premiered in Japan in April 2023 and aired for 12 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and it streamed an English dub . The second season premiered in January 2024 and aired for 12 episodes. Crunchyroll again streamed the series as it aired and streamed an English dub . Crunchyroll will stream Mashle: Magic and Muscles - Tri-Magicathalon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc , the third season based on Hajime Kōmoto 's Mashle: Magic and Muscles manga, in January. The overall anime project is listed as a "complete" anime adaptation.

The franchise also includes several novels and two stage play adaptations .

Mashle: Muscle Puzzle , a smartphone puzzle game in the franchise , launched in April 2025.
